name: Serena Kirke
source:
Serena is now the fully brainwashed sex slave of Dario Dalisso. Its been three years since she was brainwashed during the events of Isis The Fall.

After being brainwashed into Dario's sex slave, Serena is now the admiral of Section 6. Dario Dalisso wanted Serena to use her successes to leverage herself into the Section 6 admiralty. Thus, she did so. She also used her new influence to transfer Dario into section 6. 

She uses her new position to help Dario Dalisso whenever possible. 

Note that she only appears in the epilogue of Margaret's route. 

She does get mentioned several times in the game due to being the main reason that Dario is even captain of the Lamashtu. 

Her naked sex slave appearance is shown in the credits of this game regardless of the route chosen.
